title: Arjuna Vishada Yoga
summary: The first chapter describes the distress of Arjuna upon seeing his relatives, teachers, and friends on the opposing side of the battlefield. Overwhelmed by compassion and confusion about his duty, he refuses to fight.

verses.sanskrit:
धर्मक्षेत्रे कुरुक्षेत्रे समवेता युयुत्सवः |
मामकाः पाण्डवाश्चैव किमकुर्वत सञ्जय ||
verses.translation: Dhritarashtra said: O Sanjaya, after gathering on the holy field of Kurukshetra, and desiring to fight, what did my sons and the sons of Pandu do?
verses.transliteration:
dharma-kṣetre kuru-kṣetre samavetā yuyutsavaḥ
māmakāḥ pāṇḍavāś caiva kim akurvata sañjaya
verses.meaning: dharma-kṣetre - in the field of dharma; kuru-kṣetre - in Kurukshetra; samavetāḥ - assembled; yuyutsavaḥ - desiring to fight; māmakāḥ - my sons; pāṇḍavāḥ - the sons of Pandu; ca - and; eva - certainly; kim - what; akurvata - did they do; sañjaya - O Sanjaya

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवानीकं व्यूढं दुर्योधनस्तदा |
आचार्यमुपसङ्गम्य राजा वचनमब्रवीत् ||
verses.translation: Sanjaya said: On observing the Pandava army standing in military formation, King Duryodhana approached his teacher Dronacharya and spoke the following words.
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca
dṛṣṭvā tu pāṇḍavānīkaṃ vyūḍhaṃ duryodhanas tadā
ācāryam upasaṅgamya rājā vacanam abravīt
verses.meaning: sañjayaḥ uvāca - Sanjaya said; dṛṣṭvā - having seen; tu - but; pāṇḍava-anīkam - the soldiers of the Pandavas; vyūḍham - arranged in military formation; duryodhanaḥ - King Duryodhana; tadā - at that time; ācāryam - the teacher; upasaṅgamya - approaching; rājā - the king; vacanam - words; abravīt - spoke

verses.sanskrit:
पश्यैतां पाण्डुपुत्राणामाचार्य महतीं चमूम् |
व्यूढां द्रुपदपुत्रेण तव शिष्येण धीमता ||
verses.translation: O Teacher, behold the mighty army of the sons of Pandu, arrayed by the son of Drupada, your intelligent disciple.
verses.transliteration:
paśyaitāṃ pāṇḍu-putrāṇām ācārya mahatīṃ camūm
vyūḍhāṃ drupada-putreṇa tava śiṣyeṇa dhīmatā
verses.meaning: paśya - behold; etām - this; pāṇḍu-putrāṇām - of the sons of Pandu; ācārya - O teacher; mahatīm - great; camūm - army; vyūḍhām - arranged; drupada-putreṇa - by the son of Drupada; tava - your; śiṣyeṇa - disciple; dhī-matā - intelligent

verses.sanskrit:
अत्र शूरा महेष्वासा भीमार्जुनसमा युधि |
युयुधानो विराटश्च द्रुपदश्च महारथः ||
verses.translation: Here in this army are many heroic bowmen equal in fighting to Bhima and Arjuna: great fighters like Yuyudhana, Virata, and Drupada.
verses.transliteration:
atra śūrā maheṣv-āsā bhīmārjuna-samā yudhi
yuyudhāno virāṭaś ca drupadaś ca mahā-rathaḥ
verses.meaning: atra - here; śūrāḥ - heroes; mahā-iṣu-āsāḥ - mighty bowmen; bhīma-arjuna-samāḥ - equal to Bhima and Arjuna; yudhi - in battle; yuyudhānaḥ - Yuyudhana; virāṭaḥ - Virata; ca - and; drupadaḥ - Drupada; ca - also; mahā-rathaḥ - great chariot warrior

verses.sanskrit:
धृष्टकेतुश्चेकितानः काशिराजश्च वीर्यवान् |
पुरुजित्कुन्तिभोजश्च शैब्यश्च नरपुङ्गवः ||
verses.translation: There are also great, heroic, powerful fighters like Dhrishtaketu, Chekitana, the valiant King of Kashi, Purujit, Kuntibhoja, and Shaibya.
verses.transliteration:
dhṛṣṭaketuś cekitānaḥ kāśirājaś ca vīryavān
purujit kuntibhojaś ca śaibyaś ca nara-puṅgavaḥ
verses.meaning: dhṛṣṭaketuḥ - Dhrishtaketu; cekitānaḥ - Chekitana; kāśirājaḥ - King of Kashi; ca - and; vīrya-vān - powerful; purujit - Purujit; kuntibhojaḥ - Kuntibhoja; ca - and; śaibyaḥ - Shaibya; ca - and; nara-puṅgavaḥ - best among men

verses.sanskrit:
युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्त उत्तमौजाश्च वीर्यवान् |
सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्व एव महारथाः ||
verses.translation: There are the mighty Yudhamanyu, the valiant Uttamauja, the son of Subhadra, and the sons of Draupadi, all of them great chariot warriors.
verses.transliteration:
yudhāmanyuś ca vikrānta uttamaujāś ca vīryavān
saubhadro draupadeyāś ca sarva eva mahā-rathāḥ
verses.meaning: yudhāmanyuḥ - Yudhamanyu; ca - and; vikrāntaḥ - mighty; uttamaujāḥ - Uttamauja; ca - and; vīrya-vān - powerful; saubhadraḥ - the son of Subhadra; draupadeyāḥ - the sons of Draupadi; ca - and; sarve - all; eva - indeed; mahā-rathāḥ - great chariot warriors

verses.sanskrit:
अस्माकं तु विशिष्टा ये तान्निबोध द्विजोत्तम |
नायका मम सैन्यस्य संज्ञार्थं तान्ब्रवीमि ते ||
verses.translation: O best of Brahmins, for your information, let me tell you about the captains who are especially qualified to lead my military force.
verses.transliteration:
asmākaṃ tu viśiṣṭā ye tān nibodha dvijottama
nāyakā mama sainyasya saṁjñārthaṃ tān bravīmi te
verses.meaning: asmākam - our; tu - but; viśiṣṭāḥ - special; ye - who; tān - them; nibodha - be informed; dvija-uttama - O best of Brahmins; nāyakāḥ - captains; mama - my; sainyasya - of the army; saṁjñā-artham - for information; tān - them; bravīmi - I speak; te - to you

verses.sanskrit:
भवान्भीष्मश्च कर्णश्च कृपश्च समितिञ्जयः |
अश्वत्थामा विकर्णश्च सौमदत्तिस्तथैव च ||
verses.translation: There are personalities like yourself, Bhishma, Karna, Kripa, Ashvatthama, Vikarna, and the son of Somadatta, who are always victorious in battle.
verses.transliteration:
bhavān bhīṣmaś ca karṇaś ca kṛpaś ca samitiñ-jayaḥ
aśvatthāmā vikarṇaś ca saumadattis tathaiva ca
verses.meaning: bhavān - yourself; bhīṣmaḥ - Bhishma; ca - and; karṇaḥ - Karna; ca - and; kṛpaḥ - Kripa; ca - and; samitiñ-jayaḥ - victorious in battle; aśvatthāmā - Ashvatthama; vikarṇaḥ - Vikarna; ca - and; saumadattiḥ - the son of Somadatta; tathā - as well; eva - certainly; ca - also

verses.sanskrit:
अन्ये च बहवः शूरा मदर्थे त्यक्तजीविताः |
नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः ||
verses.translation: And there are many other heroes who are prepared to lay down their lives for my sake. They are all skilled in the art of warfare, and equipped with various weapons.
verses.transliteration:
anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā mad-arthe tyakta-jīvitāḥ
nānā-śastra-praharaṇāḥ sarve yuddha-viśāradāḥ
verses.meaning: anye - others; ca - also; bahavaḥ - many; śūrāḥ - heroes; mat-arthe - for my sake; tyakta-jīvitāḥ - prepared to lay down lives; nānā - various; śastra - weapons; praharaṇāḥ - equipped with; sarve - all; yuddha - in military art; viśāradāḥ - experienced

verses.sanskrit:
अपर्याप्तं तदस्माकं बलं भीष्माभिरक्षितम् |
पर्याप्तं त्विदमेतेषां बलं भीमाभिरक्षितम् ||
verses.translation: Our strength is unlimited and we are perfectly protected by Bhishma, whereas the strength of the Pandavas, carefully protected by Bhima, is limited.
verses.transliteration:
aparyāptaṃ tad asmākaṃ balaṃ bhīṣmābhirakṣitam
paryāptaṃ tv idam eteṣāṃ balaṃ bhīmābhirakṣitam
verses.meaning: aparyāptam - unlimited; tat - that; asmākam - of ours; balam - strength; bhīṣma - by Bhishma; abhirakṣitam - perfectly protected; paryāptam - limited; tu - but; idam - this; eteṣām - of the Pandavas; balam - strength; bhīma - by Bhima; abhirakṣitam - carefully protected

verses.sanskrit:
अयनेषु च सर्वेषु यथाभागमवस्थिताः |
भीष्ममेवाभिरक्षन्तु भवन्तः सर्व एव हि ||
verses.translation: Therefore, stationed in your respective positions in the military phalanx, all of you must give full support to Bhishma.
verses.transliteration:
ayaneṣu ca sarveṣu yathā-bhāgam avasthitāḥ
bhīṣmam evābhirakṣantu bhavantaḥ sarva eva hi
verses.meaning: ayaneṣu - in the strategic points; ca - also; sarveṣu - all; yathā-bhāgam - in respective positions; avasthitāḥ - stationed; bhīṣmam - to Bhishma; eva - certainly; abhirakṣantu - give support; bhavantaḥ - you; sarve - all; eva - indeed; hi - certainly

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य सञ्जनयन्हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः |
सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्खं दध्मौ प्रतापवान् ||
verses.translation: Then, the valiant Bhishma, the grandsire of the Kuru dynasty, roared like a lion and blew his conch loudly, giving joy to Duryodhana.
verses.transliteration:
tasya sañjanayan harṣaṃ kuru-vṛddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ
siṁha-nādaṃ vinadyoccaiḥ śaṅkhaṃ dadhmau pratāpavān
verses.meaning: tasya - his; sañjanayan - creating; harṣam - joy; kuru-vṛddhaḥ - the grandsire of the Kurus; pitāmahaḥ - the grandfather; siṁha-nādam - lion's roar; vinadya - sounding; uccaiḥ - very loudly; śaṅkham - conch; dadhmau - blew; pratāpa-vān - the valiant

verses.sanskrit:
ततः शङ्खाश्च भेर्यश्च पणवानकगोमुखाः |
सहसैवाभ्यहन्यन्त स शब्दस्तुमुलोऽभवत् ||
verses.translation: After that, conches, kettledrums, cymbals, drums, and trumpets were sounded all at once. The noise was tremendous.
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śaṅkhāś ca bheryaś ca paṇavānaka-gomukhāḥ
sahasaivābhyahanyanta sa śabdas tumulo 'bhavat
verses.meaning: tataḥ - thereafter; śaṅkhāḥ - conches; ca - also; bheryaḥ - large drums; ca - and; paṇava-ānaka - small drums and kettledrums; go-mukhāḥ - trumpets; sahasā - all of a sudden; eva - certainly; abhyahanyanta - were sounded; saḥ - that; śabdaḥ - sound; tumulaḥ - tumultuous; abhavat - became

verses.sanskrit:
ततः श्वेतैर्हयैर्युक्ते महति स्यन्दने स्थितौ |
माधवः पाण्डवश्चैव दिव्यौ शङ्खौ प्रदध्मतुः ||
verses.translation: Then, Lord Krishna and Arjuna, seated in a magnificent chariot yoked with white horses, blew their divine conches.
verses.transliteration:
tataḥ śvetair hayair yukte mahati syandane sthitau
mādhavaḥ pāṇḍavaś caiva divyau śaṅkhau pradadhmatuḥ
verses.meaning: tataḥ - then; śvetaiḥ - with white; hayaiḥ - horses; yukte - yoked; mahati - in a great; syandane - chariot; sthitau - situated; mādhavaḥ - Krishna; pāṇḍavaḥ - Arjuna; ca - and; eva - certainly; divyau - divine; śaṅkhau - conches; pradadhmatuḥ - blew

verses.sanskrit:
पाञ्चजन्यं हृषीकेशो देवदत्तं धनञ्जयः |
पौण्ड्रं दध्मौ महाशङ्खं भीमकर्मा वृकोदरः ||
verses.translation: Krishna blew His conch, called Panchajanya; Arjuna blew his, called Devadatta; and Bhima, the voracious eater and performer of Herculean tasks, blew his mighty conch, called Paundra.
verses.transliteration:
pāñcajanyaṃ hṛṣīkeśo devadattaṃ dhanañjayaḥ
pauṇḍraṃ dadhmau mahā-śaṅkhaṃ bhīma-karmā vṛkodaraḥ
verses.meaning: pāñcajanyam - the conch named Panchajanya; hṛṣīkeśaḥ - Krishna; devadattam - the conch named Devadatta; dhanañjayaḥ - Arjuna; pauṇḍram - the conch named Paundra; dadhmau - blew; mahā-śaṅkham - mighty conch; bhīma-karmā - one who performs Herculean tasks; vṛkodaraḥ - Bhima

verses.sanskrit:
अनन्तविजयं राजा कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः |
नकुलः सहदेवश्च सुघोषमणिपुष्पकौ ||
verses.translation: King Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, blew his conch, called Anantavijaya, and Nakula and Sahadeva blew theirs, called Sughosa and Manipushpaka.
verses.transliteration:
ananta-vijayaṃ rājā kuntī-putro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
nakulaḥ sahadevaś ca sughoṣa-maṇipuṣpakau
verses.meaning: ananta-vijayam - the conch named Anantavijaya; rājā - the king; kuntī-putraḥ - the son of Kunti; yudhiṣṭhiraḥ - Yudhishthira; nakulaḥ - Nakula; sahadevaḥ - Sahadeva; ca - and; sughoṣa-maṇipuṣpakau - the conches named Sughosa and Manipushpaka

verses.sanskrit:
काश्यश्च परमेष्वासः शिखण्डी च महारथः |
धृष्टद्युम्नो विराटश्च सात्यकिश्चापराजितः ||
verses.translation: The King of Kashi, the great archer; Shikhandi, the mighty chariot warrior; Dhrishtadyumna; Virata; and the invincible Satyaki all blew their respective conches.
verses.transliteration:
kāśyaś ca parameṣv-āsaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca mahā-rathaḥ
dhṛṣṭadyumno virāṭaś ca sātyakiś cāparājitaḥ
verses.meaning: kāśyaḥ - the King of Kashi; ca - and; parama-iṣu-āsaḥ - the great archer; śikhaṇḍī - Shikhandi; ca - also; mahā-rathaḥ - mighty chariot warrior; dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ - Dhrishtadyumna; virāṭaḥ - Virata; ca - and; sātyakiḥ - Satyaki; ca - and; aparājitaḥ - invincible

verses.sanskrit:
द्रुपदो द्रौपदेयाश्च सर्वशः पृथिवीपते |
सौभद्रश्च महाबाहुः शङ्खान्दध्मुः पृथक्पृथक् ||
verses.translation: O King, Drupada, the sons of Draupadi, and the mighty-armed son of Subhadra, all blew their respective conches.
verses.transliteration:
drupado draupadeyāś ca sarvaśaḥ pṛthivī-pate
saubhadraś ca mahā-bāhuḥ śaṅkhān dadhmuḥ pṛthak pṛthak
verses.meaning: drupadaḥ - Drupada; draupadeyāḥ - the sons of Draupadi; ca - and; sarvaśaḥ - all; pṛthivī-pate - O King; saubhadraḥ - Abhimanyu; ca - also; mahā-bāhuḥ - mighty-armed; śaṅkhān - conches; dadhmuḥ - blew; pṛthak pṛthak - each separately

verses.sanskrit:
स घोषो धार्तराष्ट्राणां हृदयानि व्यदारयत् |
नभश्च पृथिवीं चैव तुमुलो व्यनुनादयन् ||
verses.translation: The tremendous sound reverberated through the sky and the earth, shattering the hearts of your sons.
verses.transliteration:
sa ghoṣo dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ hṛdayāni vyadārayat
nabhaś ca pṛthivīṃ caiva tumulo vyanunādayan
verses.meaning: saḥ - that; ghoṣaḥ - sound; dhārtarāṣṭrāṇām - of the sons of Dhritarashtra; hṛdayāni - hearts; vyadārayat - shattered; nabhaḥ - the sky; ca - and; pṛthivīm - the earth; ca - also; eva - certainly; tumulaḥ - tumultuous; abhyanunādayan - resounding

verses.sanskrit:
अथ व्यवस्थितान्दृष्ट्वा धार्तराष्ट्रान्कपिध्वजः |
प्रवृत्ते शस्त्रसम्पाते धनुरुद्यम्य पाण्डवः ||
verses.translation: At that time, Arjuna, the son of Pandu, who was seated in his chariot, his flag marked with Hanuman, took up his bow and prepared to shoot his arrows, looking at the sons of Dhritarashtra.
verses.transliteration:
atha vyavasthitān dṛṣṭvā dhārtarāṣṭrān kapi-dhvajaḥ
pravṛtte śastra-sampāte dhanur udyamya pāṇḍavaḥ
verses.meaning: atha - then; vyavasthitān - arrayed; dṛṣṭvā - seeing; dhārtarāṣṭrān - the sons of Dhritarashtra; kapi-dhvajaḥ - one whose flag is marked with Hanuman; pravṛtte - about to commence; śastra-sampāte - the hurling of weapons; dhanuḥ - bow; udyamya - taking up; pāṇḍavaḥ - Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
हृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते |
अर्जुन उवाच |
सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये रथं स्थापय मेऽच्युत ||
verses.translation: O King, Arjuna then spoke the following words to Krishna: O Infallible One, please take my chariot between the two armies.
verses.transliteration:
hṛṣīkeśaṃ tadā vākyam idam āha mahī-pate
arjuna uvāca
senayor ubhayor madhye rathaṃ sthāpaya me 'cyuta
verses.meaning: hṛṣīkeśam - to Krishna; tadā - at that time; vākyam - words; idam - these; āha - said; mahī-pate - O King; arjunaḥ uvāca - Arjuna said; senayoḥ - of the armies; ubhayoḥ - both; madhye - between; ratham - the chariot; sthāpaya - place; me - my; acyuta - O Infallible One

verses.sanskrit:
यावदेतान्निरीक्षेऽहं योद्धुकामानवस्थितान् |
कैर्मया सह योद्धव्यमस्मिन्रणसमुद्यमे ||
verses.translation: So that I may see those who stand here, eager for battle, with whom I must contend in this great trial of war.
verses.transliteration:
yāvad etān nirīkṣe 'haṃ yoddhu-kāmān avasthitān
kair mayā saha yoddhavyam asmin raṇa-samudyame
verses.meaning: yāvat - as long as; etān - these; nirīkṣe - may look; aham - I; yoddhu-kāmān - desiring to fight; avasthitān - arrayed; kaiḥ - with whom; mayā - by me; saha - together; yoddhavyam - must fight; asmin - in this; raṇa - battle; samudyame - in the attempt

verses.sanskrit:
योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेऽहं य एतेऽत्र समागताः |
धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्बुद्धेर्युद्धे प्रियचिकीर्षवः ||
verses.translation: I wish to see those who have come here to fight, wishing to please the evil-minded son of Dhritarashtra.
verses.transliteration:
yotsyamānān avekṣe 'haṃ ya ete 'tra samāgatāḥ
dhārtarāṣṭrasya durbuddher yuddhe priya-cikīrṣavaḥ
verses.meaning: yotsyamānān - those who will be fighting; avekṣe - let me see; aham - I; ye - who; ete - those; atra - here; samāgatāḥ - assembled; dhārtarāṣṭrasya - of the son of Dhritarashtra; durbuddheḥ - evil-minded; yuddhe - in the fight; priya - well; cikīrṣavaḥ - wishing

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
एवमुक्तो हृषीकेशो गुडाकेशेन भारत |
सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये स्थापयित्वा रथोत्तमम् ||
verses.translation: Sanjaya said: O Dhritarashtra, having thus been addressed by Arjuna, Krishna drew up the magnificent chariot in the midst of the armies of both sides.
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca
evam ukto hṛṣīkeśo guḍākeśena bhārata
senayor ubhayor madhye sthāpayitvā rathottamam
verses.meaning: sañjayaḥ uvāca - Sanjaya said; evam - thus; uktaḥ - addressed; hṛṣīkeśaḥ - Krishna; guḍākeśena - by Arjuna; bhārata - O descendant of Bharata; senayoḥ - of the armies; ubhayoḥ - both; madhye - in the midst; sthāpayitvā - placing; ratha-uttamam - the magnificent chariot

verses.sanskrit:
भीष्मद्रोणप्रमुखतः सर्वेषां च महीक्षिताम् |
उवाच पार्थ पश्यैतान्समवेतान्कुरूनिति ||
verses.translation: In the presence of Bhishma, Drona, and all the other kings, Krishna said: O Partha, behold these Kurus assembled here.
verses.transliteration:
bhīṣma-droṇa-pramukhataḥ sarveṣāṃ ca mahī-kṣitām
uvāca pārtha paśyaitān samavetān kurūn iti
verses.meaning: bhīṣma - Bhishma; droṇa - Drona; pramukhataḥ - in the presence; sarveṣām - all; ca - and; mahī-kṣitām - the kings; uvāca - said; pārtha - O Arjuna; paśya - behold; etān - these; samavetān - assembled; kurūn - the members of the Kuru dynasty; iti - thus

verses.sanskrit:
तत्रापश्यत्स्थितान्पार्थः पितॄनथ पितामहान् |
आचार्यान्मातुलान्भ्रातॄन्पुत्रान्पौत्रान्सखींस्तथा ||
verses.translation: There Arjuna could see, within the midst of the armies of both parties, his fathers, grandfathers, teachers, maternal uncles, brothers, sons, grandsons, friends, and also his fathers-in-law and well-wishers.
verses.transliteration:
tatrāpaśyat sthitān pārthaḥ pitṝn atha pitāmahān
ācāryān mātulān bhrātṝn putrān pautrān sakhīṁs tathā
verses.meaning: tatra - there; apaśyat - saw; sthitān - standing; pārthaḥ - Arjuna; pitṝn - fathers; atha - also; pitāmahān - grandfathers; ācāryān - teachers; mātulān - maternal uncles; bhrātṝn - brothers; putrān - sons; pautrān - grandsons; sakhīn - friends; tathā - also

verses.sanskrit:
श्वशुरान्सुहृदश्चैव सेनयोरुभयोरपि |
तान्समीक्ष्य स कौन्तेयः सर्वान्बन्धूनवस्थितान् ||
verses.translation: When the son of Kunti, Arjuna, saw all these different grades of friends and relatives, he became overwhelmed with compassion.
verses.transliteration:
śvaśurān suhṛdaś caiva senayor ubhayor api
tān samīkṣya sa kaunteyaḥ sarvān bandhūn avasthitān
verses.meaning: śvaśurān - fathers-in-law; suhṛdaḥ - well-wishers; ca - and; eva - indeed; senayoḥ - of the armies; ubhayoḥ - both; api - also; tān - them; samīkṣya - seeing; saḥ - he; kaunteyaḥ - Arjuna; sarvān - all; bandhūn - relatives; avasthitān - situated

verses.sanskrit:
कृपया परयाविष्टो विषीदन्निदमब्रवीत् |
अर्जुन उवाच |
दृष्ट्वेमं स्वजनं कृष्ण युयुत्सुं समुपस्थितम् ||
verses.translation: Arjuna said: O Krishna, seeing my own kinsmen arrayed and eager for battle, my limbs fail and my mouth is parched.
verses.transliteration:
kṛpayā parayāviṣṭo viṣīdann idam abravīt
arjuna uvāca
dṛṣṭvemaṃ sva-janaṃ kṛṣṇa yuyutsuṃ samupasthitam
verses.meaning: kṛpayā - by compassion; parayā - great; āviṣṭaḥ - overwhelmed; viṣīdan - while lamenting; idam - these; abravīt - spoke; arjunaḥ uvāca - Arjuna said; dṛṣṭvā - seeing; imam - these; sva-janam - kinsmen; kṛṣṇa - O Krishna; yuyutsum - eager to fight; samupasthitam - present

verses.sanskrit:
सीदन्ति मम गात्राणि मुखं च परिशुष्यति |
वेपथुश्च शरीरे मे रोमहर्षश्च जायते ||
verses.translation: My limbs fail and my mouth is parched. My body trembles and my hair stands on end.
verses.transliteration:
sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṃ ca pariśuṣyati
vepathuś ca śarīre me roma-harṣaś ca jāyate
verses.meaning: sīdanti - quivering; mama - my; gātrāṇi - limbs; mukham - mouth; ca - also; pariśuṣyati - drying up; vepathuḥ - trembling; ca - and; śarīre - in the body; me - my; roma-harṣaḥ - standing of hair on end; ca - also; jāyate - taking place

verses.sanskrit:
गाण्डीवं स्रंसते हस्तात्त्वक्चैव परिदह्यते |
न च शक्नोम्यवस्थातुं भ्रमतीव च मे मनः ||
verses.translation: The Gandiva bow is slipping from my hand, and my skin is burning all over. I am unable to stand steady, and my mind is reeling.
verses.transliteration:
gāṇḍīvaṃ sraṁsate hastāt tvak caiva paridahyate
na ca śaknomy avasthātuṃ bhramatīva ca me manaḥ
verses.meaning: gāṇḍīvam - the bow named Gandiva; sraṁsate - slipping; hastāt - from the hand; tvak - skin; ca - also; eva - certainly; paridahyate - burning; na - not; ca - and; śaknomi - am able; avasthātum - to stand; bhramati - reeling; iva - as if; ca - and; me - my; manaḥ - mind

verses.sanskrit:
निमित्तानि च पश्यामि विपरीतानि केशव |
न च श्रेयोऽनुपश्यामि हत्वा स्वजनमाहवे ||
verses.translation: I see only adverse omens, O Krishna, and I do not foresee any good in killing my own kinsmen in battle.
verses.transliteration:
nimittāni ca paśyāmi viparītāni keśava
na ca śreyo 'nupaśyāmi hatvā sva-janam āhave
verses.meaning: nimittāni - omens; ca - and; paśyāmi - I see; viparītāni - adverse; keśava - O Krishna; na - not; ca - also; śreyaḥ - good; anupaśyāmi - do I foresee; hatvā - by killing; sva-janam - kinsmen; āhave - in battle

verses.sanskrit:
न काङ्क्षे विजयं कृष्ण न च राज्यं सुखानि च |
किं नो राज्येन गोविन्द किं भोगैर्जीवितेन वा ||
verses.translation: O Krishna, I do not desire victory, nor kingdom, nor pleasures. Of what use is kingdom, or enjoyment, or even life?
verses.transliteration:
na kāṅkṣe vijayaṃ kṛṣṇa na ca rājyaṃ sukhāni ca
kiṃ no rājyena govinda kiṃ bhogair jīvitena vā
verses.meaning: na - not; kāṅkṣe - do I desire; vijayam - victory; kṛṣṇa - O Krishna; na - nor; ca - also; rājyam - kingdom; sukhāni - happiness; ca - also; kim - what; naḥ - to us; rājyena - by kingdom; govinda - O Krishna; kim - what; bhogaiḥ - by enjoyments; jīvitena - by life; vā - or

verses.sanskrit:
येषामर्थे काङ्क्षितं नो राज्यं भोगाः सुखानि च |
त इमेऽवस्थिता युद्धे प्राणांस्त्यक्त्वा धनानि च ||
verses.translation: Those for whose sake we desire kingdom, enjoyments, and pleasures, are standing here in battle, having renounced their lives and wealth.
verses.transliteration:
yeṣām arthe kāṅkṣitaṃ no rājyaṃ bhogāḥ sukhāni ca
ta ime 'vasthitā yuddhe prāṇāṁs tyaktvā dhanāni ca
verses.meaning: yeṣām - for whom; arthe - for the sake; kāṅkṣitam - desired; naḥ - by us; rājyam - kingdom; bhogāḥ - enjoyments; sukhāni - pleasures; ca - also; te - they; ime - these; avasthitāḥ - situated; yuddhe - in battle; prāṇān - lives; tyaktvā - giving up; dhanāni - wealth; ca - also

verses.sanskrit:
आचार्याः पितरः पुत्रास्तथैव च पितामहाः |
मातुलाः श्वशुराः पौत्राः श्यालाः सम्बन्धिनस्तथा ||
verses.translation: Teachers, fathers, sons, grandfathers, maternal uncles, fathers-in-law, grandsons, brothers-in-law, and other relatives are present here.
verses.transliteration:
ācāryāḥ pitaraḥ putrās tathaiva ca pitāmahāḥ
mātulāḥ śvaśurāḥ pautrāḥ śyālāḥ sambandhinas tathā
verses.meaning: ācāryāḥ - teachers; pitaraḥ - fathers; putrāḥ - sons; tathā - as well; eva - certainly; ca - also; pitāmahāḥ - grandfathers; mātulāḥ - maternal uncles; śvaśurāḥ - fathers-in-law; pautrāḥ - grandsons; śyālāḥ - brothers-in-law; sambandhinaḥ - relatives; tathā - as well

verses.sanskrit:
एतान्न हन्तुमिच्छामि घ्नतोऽपि मधुसूदन |
अपि त्रैलोक्यराज्यस्य हेतोः किं नु महीकृते ||
verses.translation: O Krishna, I do not wish to kill them, even if they attack me, not even for sovereignty over the three worlds, what to speak of this earth.
verses.transliteration:
etān na hantum icchāmi ghnato 'pi madhusūdana
api trailokya-rājyasya hetoḥ kiṃ nu mahī-kṛte
verses.meaning: etān - these; na - not; hantum - to kill; icchāmi - I wish; ghnataḥ - being killed; api - even; madhusūdana - O Krishna; api - even; trai-lokya - of the three worlds; rājyasya - for the kingdom; hetoḥ - for the sake; kim nu - what to speak of; mahī-kṛte - for the earth

verses.sanskrit:
निहत्य धार्तराष्ट्रान्नः का प्रीतिः स्याज्जनार्दन |
पापमेवाश्रयेदस्मान्हत्वैतानाततायिनः ||
verses.translation: O Krishna, what pleasure will we derive from killing the sons of Dhritarashtra? Sin alone will accrue to us if we slay these felons.
verses.transliteration:
nihatya dhārtarāṣṭrān naḥ kā prītiḥ syāj janārdana
pāpam evāśrayed asmān hatvaitān ātatāyinaḥ
verses.meaning: nihatya - by killing; dhārtarāṣṭrān - the sons of Dhritarashtra; naḥ - our; kā - what; prītiḥ - pleasure; syāt - will there be; janārdana - O Krishna; pāpam - sin; eva - certainly; āśrayet - will come upon; asmān - us; hatvā - by killing; etān - these; ātatāyinaḥ - aggressors

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मान्नार्हा वयं हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान्स्वबान्धवान् |
स्वजनं हि कथं हत्वा सुखिनः स्याम माधव ||
verses.translation: Therefore, it is not proper for us to kill our own kinsmen, the sons of Dhritarashtra. O Krishna, how can we be happy after killing our own people?
verses.transliteration:
tasmān nārhā vayaṃ hantuṃ dhārtarāṣṭrān sva-bāndhavān
sva-janaṃ hi kathaṃ hatvā sukhinaḥ syāma mādhava
verses.meaning: tasmāt - therefore; na - not; arhāḥ - deserving; vayam - we; hantum - to kill; dhārtarāṣṭrān - the sons of Dhritarashtra; sva-bāndhavān - along with friends; sva-janam - kinsmen; hi - certainly; katham - how; hatvā - by killing; sukhinaḥ - happy; syāma - will we become; mādhava - O Krishna

verses.sanskrit:
यद्यप्येते न पश्यन्ति लोभोपहतचेतसः |
कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं मित्रद्रोहे च पातकम् ||
verses.translation: Although those whose minds are overpowered by greed do not see evil in the destruction of the family, nor sin in treachery to friends.
verses.transliteration:
yady apy ete na paśyanti lobhopahata-cetasaḥ
kula-kṣaya-kṛtaṃ doṣaṃ mitra-drohe ca pātakam
verses.meaning: yadi - if; api - even; ete - they; na - not; paśyanti - see; lobha - by greed; upahata - overpowered; cetasaḥ - whose minds; kula-kṣaya - in the destruction of the family; kṛtam - done; doṣam - fault; mitra-drohe - in treachery to friends; ca - and; pātakam - sin

verses.sanskrit:
कथं न ज्ञेयमस्माभिः पापादस्मान्निवर्तितुम् |
कुलक्षयकृतं दोषं प्रपश्यद्भिर्जनार्दन ||
verses.translation: Why should we, who clearly see the evil in the destruction of the family, not turn away from this sin, O Krishna?
verses.transliteration:
kathaṃ na jñeyam asmābhiḥ pāpād asmān nivartitum
kula-kṣaya-kṛtaṃ doṣaṃ prapaśyadbhir janārdana
verses.meaning: katham - why; na - not; jñeyam - should be known; asmābhiḥ - by us; pāpāt - from sin; asmāt - these; nivartitum - to turn away; kula-kṣaya - in the destruction of the family; kṛtam - done; doṣam - crime; prapaśyadbhiḥ - by those who see; janārdana - O Krishna

verses.sanskrit:
कुलक्षये प्रणश्यन्ति कुलधर्माः सनातनाः |
धर्मे नष्टे कुलं कृत्स्नमधर्मोऽभिभवत्युत ||
verses.translation: With the destruction of the family, the eternal family traditions are vanquished, and with the destruction of dharma, unrighteousness prevails over the entire family.
verses.transliteration:
kula-kṣaye praṇaśyanti kula-dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ
dharme naṣṭe kulaṃ kṛtsnam adharmo 'bhibhavaty uta
verses.meaning: kula-kṣaye - in the destruction of the family; praṇaśyanti - are vanquished; kula-dharmāḥ - family traditions; sanātanāḥ - eternal; dharme - dharma; naṣṭe - being destroyed; kulam - family; kṛtsnam - entire; adharmaḥ - unrighteousness; abhibhavati - prevails; uta - indeed

verses.sanskrit:
अधर्माभिभवात्कृष्ण प्रदुष्यन्ति कुलस्त्रियः |
स्त्रीषु दुष्टासु वार्ष्णेय जायते वर्णसङ्करः ||
verses.translation: When unrighteousness prevails, O Krishna, the women of the family become corrupted, and with the corruption of women, O descendant of Vrishni, there arises an unwanted progeny.
verses.transliteration:
adharmābhibhavāt kṛṣṇa praduṣyanti kula-striyaḥ
strīṣu duṣṭāsu vārṣṇeya jāyate varṇa-saṅkaraḥ
verses.meaning: adharma - unrighteousness; abhibhavāt - from the prevalence; kṛṣṇa - O Krishna; praduṣyanti - become corrupted; kula-striyaḥ - women of the family; strīṣu - of women; duṣṭāsu - become corrupted; vārṣṇeya - O descendant of Vrishni; jāyate - is born; varṇa-saṅkaraḥ - unwanted progeny

verses.sanskrit:
सङ्करो नरकायैव कुलघ्नानां कुलस्य च |
पतन्ति पितरो ह्येषां लुप्तपिण्डोदकक्रियाः ||
verses.translation: An increase in unwanted children results in hellish life both for the family and for those who destroy the family. Deprived of the sacrificial offerings, the ancestors of such corrupt families also fall.
verses.transliteration:
saṅkaro narakāyaiva kula-ghnānāṃ kulasya ca
patanti pitaro hy eṣāṃ lupta-piṇḍodaka-kriyāḥ
verses.meaning: saṅkaraḥ - unwanted progeny; narakāya - for hellish life; eva - certainly; kula-ghnānām - of those who destroy the family; kulasya - of the family; ca - also; patanti - fall down; pitaraḥ - ancestors; hi - certainly; eṣām - of them; lupta - stopped; piṇḍa - offerings of food; udaka - and water; kriyāḥ - performances

verses.sanskrit:
दोषैरेतैः कुलघ्नानां वर्णसङ्करकारकैः |
उत्साद्यन्ते जातिधर्माः कुलधर्माश्च शाश्वताः ||
verses.translation: Through the evil deeds of those who destroy the family and thus give rise to unwanted progeny, a variety of social and family welfare activities are ruined.
verses.transliteration:
doṣair etaiḥ kula-ghnānāṃ varṇa-saṅkara-kārakaiḥ
utsādyante jāti-dharmāḥ kula-dharmāś ca śāśvatāḥ
verses.meaning: doṣaiḥ - by such faults; etaiḥ - these; kula-ghnānām - of the destroyers of the family; varṇa-saṅkara - unwanted progeny; kārakaiḥ - by the doers; utsādyante - are ruined; jāti-dharmāḥ - social welfare activities; kula-dharmāḥ - family welfare activities; ca - and; śāśvatāḥ - eternal

verses.sanskrit:
उत्सन्नकुलधर्माणां मनुष्याणां जनार्दन |
नरकेऽनियतं वासो भवतीत्यनुशुश्रुम ||
verses.translation: O Krishna, I have heard from the learned that those who destroy family traditions dwell in hell for an indefinite period of time.
verses.transliteration:
utsanna-kula-dharmāṇāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ janārdana
narake 'niyataṃ vāso bhavatīty anuśuśruma
verses.meaning: utsanna - destroyed; kula-dharmāṇām - whose family traditions; manuṣyāṇām - of such men; janārdana - O Krishna; narake - in hell; aniyatam - indefinite; vāsaḥ - dwelling; bhavati - is; iti - thus; anuśuśruma - I have heard

verses.sanskrit:
अहो बत महत्पापं कर्तुं व्यवसिता वयम् |
यद्राज्यसुखलोभेन हन्तुं स्वजनमुद्यताः ||
verses.translation: Alas! How strange it is that we are preparing to commit greatly sinful acts, driven by the desire to enjoy royal happiness, we are intent on killing our own kinsmen.
verses.transliteration:
aho bata mahat pāpaṃ kartuṃ vyavasitā vayam
yad rājya-sukha-lobhena hantuṃ sva-janam udyatāḥ
verses.meaning: aho - alas; bata - how; mahat - great; pāpam - sins; kartum - to perform; vyavasitāḥ - have decided; vayam - we; yat - because; rājya-sukha-lobhena - driven by greed for royal happiness; hantum - to kill; sva-janam - kinsmen; udyatāḥ - trying

verses.sanskrit:
यदि मामप्रतीकारमशस्त्रं शस्त्रपाणयः |
धार्तराष्ट्रा रणे हन्युस्तन्मे क्षेमतरं भवेत् ||
verses.translation: It would be better for me if the sons of Dhritarashtra, with weapons in hand, were to kill me unarmed and unresisting on the battlefield.
verses.transliteration:
yadi mām apratīkāram aśastraṃ śastra-pāṇayaḥ
dhārtarāṣṭrā raṇe hanyus tan me kṣema-taraṃ bhavet
verses.meaning: yadi - if; mām - me; apratīkāram - without retaliation; aśastram - without weapons; śastra-pāṇayaḥ - those with weapons in hand; dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ - the sons of Dhritarashtra; raṇe - in the battlefield; hanyuḥ - may kill; tat - that; me - for me; kṣema-taram - better; bhavet - would be

verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच |
एवमुक्त्वार्जुनः सङ्ख्ये रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् |
विसृज्य सशरं चापं शोकसंविग्नमानसः ||
verses.translation: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus on the battlefield, Arjuna cast aside his bow and arrows, and sat down on the chariot, his mind overwhelmed with grief.
verses.transliteration:
sañjaya uvāca
evam uktvārjunaḥ saṅkhye rathopastha upāviśat
visṛjya sa-śaraṃ cāpaṃ śoka-saṁvigna-mānasaḥ
verses.meaning: sañjayaḥ uvāca - Sanjaya said; evam - thus; uktvā - speaking; arjunaḥ - Arjuna; saṅkhye - in the battlefield; ratha - of the chariot; upasthe - on the seat; upāviśat - sat down; visṛjya - casting aside; sa-śaram - with arrows; cāpam - the bow; śoka - by grief; saṁvigna - distressed; mānasaḥ - mind
